BLOOMBERG: US Decides Against Renewing USMCA, Shifting to Rolling Talks
July 1, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Bloomberg casts the switch to annual reviews as a slow-motion threat — "prolonged uncertainty" that could stall Mexico's peso rally and its nearshoring boom.

🔍 The number the framing leans on: 85% of Mexico's US-bound goods currently enter tariff-free — presented as Mexican fragility, not as leverage Mexico holds inside deeply integrated North American supply chains.

• Section 232 tariffs have already cut Mexico's steel exports 36.6% and auto shipments 5.1% year-over-year.
• "Yearly reviews would put a drag on one of the best currency rallies in emerging markets." — BBVA

NBC NEWS: Trump won't renew USMCA, "toppling one of the last pillars of stability in global trade"
July 1, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Trump, who in 2019 called the USMCA "the best and most important trade deal ever made by the USA," now walks from his own deal — and NBC's story quotes not a single Mexican official.

🇲🇽 What NBC left out: Mexico's economy minister Marcelo Ebrard said Mexico already signed a 16-year extension and sees "no difference between Mexico, the US and Canada so big that we cannot resolve it."

• "The primary issue the president's been focused on is our trade deficit."
• "Our trade deficits with both Mexico and Canada shot up during the Biden administration."

🇲🇽📊 <u>MEXICAN INFLATION COOLS TO 3.55%, LOWEST IN OVER A YEAR</u>

Annual inflation fell to 3.55% in the first half of June, down from 4.45% in April, INEGI reports — led by falling prices for tomato, egg and produce after coordinated action between Pemex, the Energy Ministry and producers. Banxico is holding its rate at 6.50%, with room now to ease.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>PAN GOVERNOR FUNNELED STATE CONTRACTS TO HER OWN REAL-ESTATE FIRM</u>

An investigation found Chihuahua governor Maru Campos (PAN) owns 98% of a real-estate company that won lease contracts from her own administration — the same firm linked to her inherited "Golden Mansion" valued at 26 million pesos. President Sheinbaum has referred the case to the federal auditor (ASF) for a conflict-of-interest probe.

🇲🇽🇻🇪 <u>MEXICO SENDS 5 AID FLIGHTS AND 240 TROOPS TO EARTHQUAKE-HIT VENEZUELA</u>

While Washington keeps Caracas under sanctions, Mexico's Defense Ministry has flown five humanitarian airlifts to earthquake-devastated Venezuela — 240 soldiers including 151 rescuers, 13.1 tons of medicine and 4 tons of equipment — and the Air Force is repatriating 26 Mexican nationals on the same planes.

🇲🇽⚽ <u>MEXICO'S WORLD CUP HAUL HITS 45 BILLION PESOS IN 20 DAYS</u>

Concanaco president Octavio de la Torre says the 2026 World Cup has already generated a 45-billion-peso economic spillover across Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey — packed hotels, restaurants and tourism — with the chamber projecting 65 billion by the final whistle.

🇲🇽💵 <u>TRUMP TAXED THE REMITTANCES. THEY GREW ANYWAY.</u>

Washington slapped a 1% tax on the money migrants send home. May's figure from Banxico: $5.611 billion, up 3.8% year-on-year — a fourth straight month of growth, with the average transfer rising 5.6% to $404. The workers the empire deports and taxes still moved $63.17 billion homeward over the last twelve months. (El Financiero)

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SOUTH KOREA EYES THE INTEROCEANIC CORRIDOR — MEXICO'S OTHER CANAL</u>

South Korean capital is circling the Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Seoul's ambassador Jooil Lee told Mexican officials his country wants "to create conditions favoring constant trade and investment," as customs chief Héctor Romero opened cooperation talks around the Interoceanic Corridor — the Pacific-to-Atlantic rail-and-port project the 4T built as a sovereign alternative to Panama. Diversification, one investor delegation at a time.

🇲🇽📊 <u>THE 'YOUTH ABANDONING THE LEFT' STORY DIES AT THE RIO GRANDE</u>

While the international press insists young people everywhere are drifting right, Sheinbaum put a number on it: more than 55% of Mexicans aged 18-29 back the Fourth Transformation, per her government's tracking and outside studies. "It's not so much that young people lack acceptance of our government," she noted. The demographic Washington's think tanks keep writing off is over half in her column.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>THE 'SHIELD OF THE AMERICAS' — AND THE TWO COUNTRIES THAT WON'T SALUTE</u>

Contralínea maps Washington's new hemispheric military bloc, launched in Miami on March 7 with Rubio, Hegseth and Bessent and signed by a dozen governments from Argentina to Panama. Two names are missing: Mexico and Brazil — "the two principal countries that presently constrain absolute US hegemony over Latin America." The pitch is security; the product is access to oil, lithium, minerals and water, with every left government pre-labeled "narco-terrorist."
